## Core Services & Products
- **SAMStack CRM**: All-in-one enterprise customer relationship management platform featuring Groq AI Excel/CSV smart ingestion, drag-and-drop Kanban pipelines, real-time outreach metrics, and role-based access control.
- **Enterprise Web Engineering**: Scalable multi-tenant applications built with Next.js 16, React 19, and Supabase.
- **Backend & Cloud Architecture**: High-concurrency RESTful and GraphQL APIs with sub-80ms response latency using FastAPI, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
- **Mobile App Development**: Cross-platform iOS & Android apps built in React Native.
- **Data Science & AI Automation**: Custom business intelligence pipelines, Python analytics, and Groq LLM integrations.
